source_text: Excoriant holocaustum et divident illud membratim; filii Aaron ignem et ligna et membra divisa imponunt. Vitulus — Christus; corium litterae detractum spiritalem sensum aperit. Membratim dividere — ordinare profectus: incipientibus, proficientibus, perfectis aptare doctrinam. Ligna altaris — usque ad lignum passio carnis; ignis desursum divinitatis. Interanea et pedes aqua lavantur — baptismi sacramentum.
pass_a_gloss: They-flay burnt-offering and will-divide it limb-by-limb; sons of-Aaron fire and woods and limbs divided place-on. Calf — Christ; hide of-letter drawn-off spiritual sense opens. Limb-by-limb to-divide — to-order advances: to-beginners, to-progressing, to-perfect to-fit teaching. Woods of-altar — up to wood passion of-flesh; fire from-above of-divinity. Inwards and feet with-water are-washed — of-baptism sacrament.
pass_b_english: [[They shall flay the burnt offering and cut it limb from limb; Aaron’s sons put fire, wood, and the divided pieces on the altar >> Bible:Leviticus 1:6-9]]. The calf is Christ; stripping the hide of the letter opens the spiritual sense. To divide limb by limb is to order progress — fitting teaching to beginners, to those advancing, and to the perfect. Altar wood reaches to the wood of the passion; the fire from above is divinity. Inwards and feet washed with water announce the sacrament of baptism — [[who is clean needs only to wash the feet >> Bible:John 13:10]].
